items.name: Proofpoint, Inc.
items.description:
Overview
Proofpoint Prime streamlines security operations for Microsoft environments by minimizing triage-worthy alerts with industry-leading 99.999% detection accuracy. It reduces labor costs and mitigates threat impact through automated workflows and integrated response capabilities—improving workforce efficiency by up to 75%. Designed to enhance Microsoft security investments, Prime delivers a comprehensive solution from a single strategic partner to stop human-centric attacks across multiple channels and stages.
 
Better Together with Microsoft
Prime extends and strengthens native Microsoft protections by filling critical visibility, detection and response vectors that attackers frequently exploit. Together, Proofpoint and Microsoft provide broader threat coverage, deeper context and faster remediation—helping organizations get more protection and more value from their existing Microsoft ecosystem.
 
Comprehensive Protection Across Microsoft Workflows
Prime safeguards employees across the tools they use every day, including Microsoft 365 email, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint, browsers and cloud apps—along with broader collaboration, messaging and file-sharing services. Nexus AI ensures consistent, cross-channel detection to eliminate blind spots and provide full-surface protection.
 
Advanced Detection and Response
Prime identifies and remediates account takeovers, lateral movement and supply chain attacks through a unified workflow that complements Microsoft’s native signals. It provides full visibility across digital channels, accelerates investigations and correlates activity to highlight true risk. Security teams can identify at-risk employees, access AI-driven behavioral insights and apply adaptive controls. Employees receive real-time, risk-based coaching tailored to their exposure and roles.
 
Brand and Domain Protection
Prime protects trusted Microsoft-hosted domains from impersonation, spoofing and malicious lookalikes with integrated authentication, dynamic discovery of fraudulent domains and coordinated takedown services.
 
Why Prime + Microsoft
Microsoft provides strong foundational security; Prime adds unmatched detection accuracy and comprehensive human-centric threat prevention that Microsoft alone cannot deliver. Together, they protect users across every channel, strengthen resilience, defend against compromised user and supplier accounts and provide deep insights into human risk—ensuring more complete security for Microsoft environments."

items.name: Cloudhouse
items.description:
Cloudhouse helps enterprises change their Microsoft estates without downtime. Run legacy Windows applications on Windows 11, Windows Server 2025 and Azure without rewriting code, and see every configuration change across your hybrid estate before it turns into an outage.

Since 2010, more than 500 enterprises have used Cloudhouse to modernise and control their estates, including NYSE, Home Office, Jaguar Land Rover, NAB and Ascensus.

What we do on Microsoft platforms
• Guardian: configuration drift detection, change validation and continuous compliance for hybrid estates. Monitors every configuration item (CI) across Windows Server, Azure, AWS, GCP and on-premises, reconciles each change against ServiceNow, Freshservice, Ivanti Neurons or BMC Helix, and checks it against built-in CIS Benchmarks.
• Alchemy: runs legacy Windows applications from Windows XP, Windows 7 and Windows Server 2003 to 2012 on Windows 10, Windows 11 and Windows Server 2016 to 2025, on-premises or in Azure. Agentless packaging, no source code changes, deployed through Intune or Configuration Manager.
• Foundry: application packaging at scale, from VMs to containers and from desktop to virtual. MSIX-ready output for Azure Virtual Desktop App Attach.

Why customers choose Cloudhouse
• 100% migration success, guaranteed: we deliver your application running on the latest Windows OS, or your money back
• No rewrites, no source code and no installers needed
• Built for regulated sectors: FCA, SOX, DORA, NIS2, PCI-DSS and ISO 27001
• G-Cloud 14 listed and ISO 9001 certified
• 24/7 customer support

Talk to us about Windows 10 and Windows Server 2012 end of support, Windows 11 and Windows Server 2025 migrations, VMware exit, or keeping change under control in regulated estates.
